product.title: San Francisco Bay Sunset & City Lights Cruise

description.text: Board at Pier 43 1/2 for a two-hour sightseeing cruise on San Francisco Bay timed for sunset in warmer months or evening city lights in winter. The route stays on the water, with indoor and outdoor viewing areas as the vessel moves between Fisherman’s Wharf, the Golden Gate Bridge area, Alcatraz, the downtown skyline, and the Bay Bridge. This is a relaxed harbor cruise rather than a narrated city tour, so the experience is best suited to travelers who want bay views, open-deck time, and a simple round-trip departure from the waterfront.

highlights: Cruise San Francisco Bay during sunset season or after dark on winter city-lights departures.
See waterfront views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, the skyline, and the Bay Bridge from the water.
Board directly at the Red and White Fleet pier near Fisherman’s Wharf.
Use indoor seating or outdoor deck space depending on weather and personal preference.

start.description: San Francisco Cruises (Red and White Fleet), Pier 43 1/2, San Francisco, CA 94133. Arrive before the scheduled departure for boarding.

end.description: This round-trip cruise returns to the same Pier 43 1/2 meeting point.

itineraryItems.title: Pier 43½
itineraryItems.description: Board at Pier 43½ on the Fisherman’s Wharf waterfront before the vessel leaves the dock for the bay route.

itineraryItems.title: Golden Gate Bridge
itineraryItems.description: The route reaches the western bay for Golden Gate Bridge views from the water before turning back toward central San Francisco Bay.

itineraryItems.title: San Francisco Bay
itineraryItems.description: The cruise crosses open San Francisco Bay waters between the waterfront, bridge corridors, and island landmarks.

itineraryItems.title: Marina District
itineraryItems.description: The vessel passes the Marina District shoreline while moving along the northern San Francisco waterfront.

itineraryItems.title: Fort Mason
itineraryItems.description: The route passes Fort Mason, a former military post on the waterfront west of Fisherman’s Wharf.

itineraryItems.title: Coit Tower
itineraryItems.description: Coit Tower appears above Telegraph Hill as the cruise returns toward the downtown waterfront.

itineraryItems.title: Bay Bridge
itineraryItems.description: The route includes Bay Bridge views where the bridge spans the bay between San Francisco and the East Bay.

itineraryItems.title: Yerba Buena Island
itineraryItems.description: The cruise passes near Yerba Buena Island along the Bay Bridge corridor.

itineraryItems.title: Treasure Island
itineraryItems.description: Treasure Island sits off the Bay Bridge route and remains part of the cruise’s central bay sightseeing sequence.

inclusions: Two-hour San Francisco Bay sunset or city-lights cruise
additionalInfo: Food, drinks, and snacks may be available to purchase from the onboard bar.
You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

faqs.question: Where does the San Francisco Bay Sunset & City Lights Cruise depart?
faqs.answer: The cruise departs from the Red and White Fleet at Pier 43 1/2 near Fisherman’s Wharf in San Francisco.

faqs.question: Does this cruise return to the same pier?
faqs.answer: Yes. This is a round-trip bay cruise that ends back at the Pier 43 1/2 meeting point.

faqs.question: Is this a narrated sightseeing cruise?
faqs.answer: No. The product is positioned as a relaxed sunset or city-lights cruise without onboard narration.
